A rivet rotational feeding method of the F-SPR system of claim 11 for joining workpieces
Step 1, placing the rivet vertically under the driving spindle and applying appropriate resistance to restrain the axial translational motion and rotational motion of the rivet
Step 2, feeding the driving spindle straightly downwards to the upper surface of the rivet at a high rate

Step 3, feeding the driving spindle axially downward slowly and, at the same time, rotating the driving spindle to match the central positioning structures of the driving spindle automatically with the positioning structures in the center of the rivet head; Making the rotary driving structures on the bottom of the driving spindle contacting with the driving structures on the top of the rivet head; The mating surfaces of the rivet head and on the driving spindle contacting with each other, wherein the bottom surface of the driving spindle contacting with the top surface of the rivet head; during the matting of the driving spindle and the rivet, when the axial pressing force of the circumferential torque exerted on the rivet by the driving spindle exceeds the external resistance applied to the rivet, the rivet starts to move axially or circumferentially with the driving spindle
